review_evidence: README identifies the repository as the development tree for formalized condensed mathematics due to Clausen and Scholze, with material intended for Mathlib.

32 of 41 Lean files contain proposition declarations spanning filtered categorical constructions, sites/sheaves, free condensed objects, light/solid modules and accessible-category/adjoint-functor machinery.
The source is substantive mathematical formalization, including both Mathlib-ready and work-in-progress project results.
summary: Reviewed LeanCondensed; retain the condensed-mathematics/category-theory development.
